source_text:
μαθημάτων, ἤδη πέντε ἔτεσιν αὐτῷ προσκαρτερήσαντα πρὶν ἢ ἐμὲ ἄρξασθαι ἀκούειν
ἐκείνων τῶν λόγων· δι' ὃν καὶ πρότερον κοινῇ ἐσθῆτι χρώμενος ἀποδυσάμενος καὶ
φιλόσοφον ἀναλαβὼν σχῆμα μέχρι τοῦ δεῦρο τηρεῖ βιβλία τε Ἑλλήνων κατὰ
δύναμιν οὐ παύεται φιλολογῶν.
pass_a_gloss: studies, already attending him five years before I began to hear those discourses; because of him he earlier used common clothing, put it off, took a philosophers habit and keeps it to this day, and as far as he can he does not cease studying Greek books.
pass_b_english: studies — already five years with him before I began those lectures. For his sake he laid aside ordinary dress, took the philosophers cloak, and still wears it; and as he is able he never stops reading Greek books.

choices.choice: English covers only this rem slice of the shared lock.
A is a sense gloss; B is literary without dropping the slices claims.
